titleArabic: Ali Mawla Ali Mawla Ali Dam Dam
titleEnglish: Ali Mawla Ali Mawla Ali Dam Dam — Traditional

verses.ar:
Ali Maula Ali Maula Ali Dam Dam
Lakh te Karoor wari akkho dam dam
verses.en:
Ali is the Master, Ali is the Master, Ali with every breath
Say it a hundred thousand million times with every breath

verses.ar:
Ali nu yaad karo
Ral ke farrayad karo
Hai ghareeban da aye ho aasra
verses.en:
Remember Ali
Together call out to him
He is the refuge of the helpless

verses.ar:
Ali sade dillan wich
Ali sade sahwan wich
Ali saday asse paase
Ali hai nigawan wich
Ashkaan de deray par
Ali diyan rahwan wich
Rab Rakhe Sariyan nu
Ali di panawan wich
verses.en:
Ali is within our hearts
Ali is within our breaths
Ali is all around us
Ali watches over us
At the abode of tears
We walk in Ali's paths
May God keep everyone
In the shelter of Ali

verses.ar:
Eh nabi da pyara Ali Noor Allah Noor
Ali da aye Allah Allah
Kabbay wich zahoor
Ali peer peeranda aye, Dillan da suroor
Wallian de sirran da aye taaj Ali Ali
Momin'nan di bas ha meraj Ali Ali
verses.en:
He is the Prophet's beloved — Ali, the light of God, is light
Ali's presence is God — God
Manifested in the Kaaba
Ali is the master of all masters, the joy of all hearts
Ali is the crown upon the heads of all saints
For believers, Ali alone is the summit of ascent

verses.ar:
Hay gin gin dassa ki main Ali de karam
Ali di pehchan aye rab di pehchan
Ali dian taqtan nu jaanda jahan
verses.en:
How can I count and tell the mercies of Ali?
To know Ali is to know the Lord
The world recognises the throne of Ali

verses.ar:
Rab da aye sheri uchhi Ali di aye shaan
Kul aye Imaan Ali Nabi da elaan
Haider e karaar, Bu turab Ali Ali
Hashmi jawan lajawaab Ali Ali
Jinhan da na koi, Ali onhan da bharam
verses.en:
God's lion — exalted is the glory of Ali
The entirety of faith is Ali — the declaration of the Prophet
Haider the steadfast, the father of soil — Ali, Ali
The incomparable young Hashimi — Ali, Ali
Those who have no one — Ali is their honour
